text:
Olivia: Quick sync — planning a regional rollforward to swap a new routing policy into eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. Target window: 2026-03-17 22:00 UTC (today). Who can own the deploy?

Sasha: I can own the deploy. I'll coordinate smoke checks and be the primary for rollback.

Jordan: I'll be infra on-call during the window. Proposal: start canary at 2% for 15m, then 10% for 10m, then increase if green.

Priya: Agree on 2% start. Recommend lowering DNS TTL to 20s for the first 30m then restore to 60s. Also confirm health-checks: 5xx rate < 1% and p50 latency < 250ms.

Alex: I can handle the TTL change. Plan: change TTL at T-5m, revert T+30m. I'll post the exact commands before we start.

infra-bot: automation: preflight checks scheduled — k8s pod health, ALB 5xx baseline, Kv-cache hitrate, recent deploys within 24h.

Olivia: Rollback plan (brief): revert routing policy weights to previous values and repoint edge to legacy pool. If errors spike >1% above baseline or latency regresses, rollback immediately.

Sasha: Runbook link: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/region-rollforward (internal). Quick steps:
1) Run preflight checks
2) Lower TTL
3) Apply canary `routerctl apply --policy rollout-v3 --canary 2`
4) Wait 15m, run smoke suite
5) Promote to 10% then 50% then full per checklist
6) If failure, `routerctl revert --policy rollout-v3 --to previous`

Nathan: I'll open an ephemeral watch channel and stream traces. Smoke command I will run: `curl -sSf -H "X-Smoke: rollforward" https://eu-west.api.redwood.com/health` — will post results.

Priya: Pushed the intended policy snippet to the repo for review:
```
{
  "eu-west-1": { "legacy_pool": 80, "new_pool": 20 },
  "ap-southeast-1": { "legacy_pool": 90, "new_pool": 10 }
}
```

Sasha: Command I'll run at T0: `routerctl apply --policy rollout-v3 --canary 2 --note "eu rollforward"`

ops-oncall: I'll be standing by to execute rollback if triggered. Ping me 10m before cutover and I'll join the watch channel.

Alex: Also disable scale-up surge for autoscaler for the first 20m to avoid noise from transient load spikes. Done in infra config.

Sasha: :thumbsup: acked. I'll post timestamps at each step and update the ephemeral channel with smoke outputs.

Olivia: Thanks — if everyone OK, Sasha, please post a final readiness ack and we'll proceed with the TTL change + canary at 22:00 UTC.

Sasha: Ready. Posting final ack here. Starting at 22:00 UTC. infra-bot: please create watch channel `#rollforward-2387654321` and schedule reminder.

infra-bot: created channel #rollforward-2387654321 and scheduled reminder 10m before 22:00 UTC.

Olivia: Great. Closing prep — see you in the watch channel. Keep rollback path clear and don't hesitate to stop the rollout if anything looks off.
